test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 15 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

I _ F I _ N D _ F _ I N N _ I F F _ N _ D

options.text: D D F F I D N
F F I I D N N
I D D F I D N
F N I F D I N

solution:
Given series : I _ F I _ N D _ F _ I N N _ I F F _ N _ D

After filling in the blanks with letters given in the option we get, 

1. D D F F I D N

I __**D **__F I__** D**__ N D __**F**__ F__** F**__ I N N __**I**__ I F F __**D**__ N __**N**__ D → Doesn't follow any pattern

2. F F I I D N N

I __**F**____ __F I__ F__ N D **__I__** F__ I__ I N N **__D__** I F F **__N__** N __N__ D → Doesn't follow any pattern.

3. I D D F I D N

I __**I**____ __F I__ D__ N D **__D__** F__ F__ I N N __**I**__ I F F **__D__** N __N__ D → Doesn't follow any pattern.

4. F N I F D I N

I __**F**____** __**F I__ N__ N D / **__I__** F__ F__ I N N **__D __** / I F F **__I__** N __N__ D → A particular pattern is repeating itself.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the **correct answer.**
